movelist.name: Fire Blast
movelist.effect: Fire Blast burns the target on 19+.

movelist.name: Calm Mind
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Light Screen
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Light Screen may activate it when receiving Special Damage to resist the Damage one step. Light Screen may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Night Shade
movelist.effect: The target loses Hit Points equal to the level of Night Shade’s user. Do not apply weakness or resistance. Do not apply stats.

movelist.name: Flame Burst
movelist.effect: Any Trainers or Pokémon cardinally adjacent to the target lose 5 Hit Points.

movelist.name: Stored Power
movelist.effect: For every Combat Stage the user has above 0, add +2 to Stored Power’s Damage Base, up to a maximum of Damage Base 20.

abilities.effect: The user receives +1 Combat Stage in their highest non-HP stat.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.effect: The user may activate this Ability to use a Move with a Damage Base of 6 (before applying STAB or other modifiers) or lower as if it had the Priority keyword. If it hits, the target is Flinched and has a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Aftermath
abilities.effect: The user creates a Burst 1. Everything in the Burst loses three Ticks of Hit Points.
